key_provisions_or_claims: Reviews pessimistic and optimistic forecasts of AI-driven automation effects on employment.
Warns of labor market polarization and obsolete professions.
Recommends mandatory IT subjects in curricula and support for online course providers.
Proposes AI and robotics institutes and departments, scholarships and public-private-academic cooperation.
Urges more state R&D funding and fiscal incentives for technology start-ups.
annotation.summary_en: Ukrainian journal article examining how AI and robotics affect employment, contrasting pessimistic and optimistic forecasts, and proposing national education reforms (IT curricula, AI/robotics institutes, scholarships, public-private cooperation, fiscal incentives) to keep Ukraine's workforce competitive.

annotation.title_en: Employment and Education Policies in the Era of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics
